name: Salami
siboNotes: Plain salami is FODMAP-free, but check ingredients for garlic powder or onion powder which are high FODMAP additives.
preparationTips: Always read ingredient labels carefully as some brands contain garlic or onion powder
Choose uncured or naturally cured varieties when possible to avoid excess additives
Remove casing if it seems tough or causes digestive discomfort
Pair with low-FODMAP crackers made from rice or oats
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of B vitamins, especially B12
High in sodium - consume in moderation
